mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear and pleasant 70 degrees near Verona Area High School with the moon in a waning gibbous phase.

The Verona Police Department Records Section processes official paperwork including crash reports and requests for documents. Most motor vehicle crash forms are available online 10 days after an incident, while other requests may take up to 10 business days to process due to necessary legal redactions.

There is plenty to do in town with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, the Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's, plus the downtown farmer's market.
On Monday July 27, a Verona police drone officer assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office in locating a person who fled from a residence.
Today is the perfect day for a Chocolate Covered Strawberry flavor of the day, and you can also visit the Kona Ice truck at Fireman Park today from 11 AM to 2 PM.
